name: EXM_EXPENSE_TYPES
description: This table contains the expense types defined for an expense report template and the associated corporate policies.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an expense type in an expense template.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense template that contains the expense type.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the expense type as appears in the expense report.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the expense type.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the expense template is available for use in expense reports.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the expense template can no longer be used.

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Expense category assigned to the expense item.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Default tax code assigned to the expense item.

columns.name: RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether receipts are required for cash expense lines above a specified amount.

columns.name: RECEIPT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Amount limit, above which a cash expense requires receipt.

columns.name: CC_RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether receipts are required for corporate card expense lines above a specified limit.

columns.name: CC_RECEIPT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Amount limit, above which a corporate card expense requires receipt.

columns.name: NEGATIVE_RCPT_REQ_CODE
columns.description: Receipt requirement rules are applied to negative expense lines.

columns.name: RCPT_REQUIRED_PROJ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether a receipt is required for this project-enabled expense type.

columns.name: DISP_RCPT_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether a receipt missing policy warning is displayed to the user.

columns.name: ITEMIZATION_BEHAVIOUR_CODE
columns.description: Indicator of whether itemization is disabled, enabled, or required for this expense type.

columns.name: ITEMIZATION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether this expense type is used only in itemization.

columns.name: DEFAULT_PROJ_EXPEND_TYPE
columns.description: Project expenditure type that is assigned to an expense type that has not been set up at the project level.

columns.name: ENABLE_PROJECTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the expense type can be used to charge project expenses.

columns.name: PREPAID_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether prepayment is allowed for the expense type.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the general ledger account that accounts for this expense type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_BEHAVIOUR_CODE

columns.name: NUM_OF_DAYS_BEHAVIOUR_CODE

columns.name: MERCHANT_BEHAVIOUR_CODE
columns.description: Behavior of the Merchant field, which is defined at the expense type level.

columns.name: TAX_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Tax product category assigned to expense type to determine the recoverable tax for an expense.
